name: minecraft-mcp
description: Control your Minecraft client with JsMacros scripts, screenshots and player takeover. Includes the MCP server and companion Skill.

interface.shortDescription: Play and inspect your Minecraft client
interface.longDescription: Connect to the Minecraft MCP client mod through a local stdio MCP server. Run JsMacros scripts, read output, capture the game view and report progress. The player can take over with /mcp stop. Requires Node.js 22+ and Minecraft with the companion mod and JsMacros. Running them on the same computer as your agent is recommended. Configure the port and token in the agent MCP environment. Baritone is optional.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my Minecraft client and show me what is happening.
Help me gather resources in Minecraft, with progress updates.
